about.label: About Noble
about.title: Where Luxury Meets Precision
about.body: Noble VIP Transfer redefines airport transportation in Antalya. We believe every journey deserves the finest vehicle, the most professional chauffeur, and the highest level of personal service. From the moment your flight lands, we are present — so you never have to wait.
about.feature_1_body: Your chauffeur awaits at arrivals with a personalised name board.
about.feature_2_body: We monitor your flight in real time. Delays don't cost you a thing.
about.feature_3_body: Travel exclusively in our Mercedes Vito VIP — the pinnacle of transfer comfort.
about.feature_4_body: Day or night, early morning or late evening — we are always here for you.

vehicle.label: Our Fleet
vehicle.title: Mercedes Vito VIP
vehicle.subtitle: One vehicle. Chosen for perfection.
vehicle.body: We offer a single, handpicked vehicle: the Mercedes Vito VIP. Immaculately maintained, equipped with premium leather seating, climate control, ambient lighting, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Every detail has been considered for your utmost comfort.

testimonials.label: Guest Reviews
testimonials.title: What Our Guests Say
testimonials.subtitle: Trusted by thousands of international travellers.

reviews.name: James Thornton
reviews.text: Absolutely flawless service from start to finish. The driver was waiting for us the moment we came through arrivals. The Vito was immaculate. Will use Noble every single time we visit Antalya.

reviews.name: Monika Schreiber
reviews.text: Wir waren begeistert! Pünktlich, professionell und das Fahrzeug war makellos sauber. Die Kommunikation lief reibungslos und der Fahrer war sehr hilfsbereit. Absolute Empfehlung!

reviews.name: Anastasia Volkov
reviews.text: Великолепный сервис! Водитель встретил нас с табличкой, помог с багажом, автомобиль был в идеальном состоянии. Поездка прошла комфортно и безопасно. Обязательно закажем снова!

reviews.name: Sophie Laurent
reviews.text: Service exceptionnel! Le chauffeur était très professionnel et le véhicule d'un luxe incroyable. Transfer parfait de l'aéroport jusqu'à notre hôtel à Belek. Je recommande vivement Noble.

reviews.name: Mehmet Yıldız
reviews.text: Antalya'daki en iyi transfer hizmeti. Zamanında, temiz araç, profesyonel şoför. Müşteri hizmetleri de çok ilgili. Kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum, bir daha kullanacağım.

reviews.name: David Okafor
reviews.text: Pure excellence. From the first WhatsApp message to the final drop-off, everything was handled with precision and care. The Mercedes Vito was spotless and incredibly comfortable.

reviews.name: Isabella Rossi
reviews.text: Servizio impeccabile! L'autista ci attendeva puntuale all'uscita degli arrivi. L'auto era lussuosa e confortevole. Prezzo giusto per un servizio premium. Torneremo sicuramente.

reviews.name: Henrik Larsson
reviews.text: Best transfer service we have ever used anywhere in the world. Professional, punctual, and the vehicle is genuinely luxurious. Noble VIP is in a completely different league.
